records.body:

Your workspace for Granite Logistics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14 with no project, no invite, no milestone; customer's only reply [email:94b74bc5] was a polite brush-off with no stated plan or blocker, after three nudges (546dabab, 547b782d, ce13ed1d) produced no action. No tickets, so no engagement signal. Low but nonzero self-start chance in 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Granite Logistics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick reply — glad things are good so far, and no pressure at all.

One thing that tends to make the first couple of weeks useful: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually the turning point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you — just name a time that suits.

Best,
Chidi
